question: Is Ferris able to use something like Behomazun (note: healing spell from Dragon Quest) that restores a a specific number of people, or a wide-area battlefield restoration or something like that?
answer: The mental image I have of it is that healing magic needs to be able to look at the target to see the level of injury and such, so it can't do the 'Wide-Area Healing!' sort of thing. Like a doctor, each person needs to be diagnosed, is the image.
